title: ALIGN
paper_title: Scaling Up Visual and Vision-Language Representation Learning With Noisy Text Supervision
core_mech: ALIGN 的主要贡献不是新交互模块，而是简单 EfficientNet/BERT 双塔在十亿级未精洗图文对上的规模化训练。
core_mech_en: Demonstrates that a simple EfficientNet + BERT dual encoder trained on over one billion noisy web image–alt-text pairs learns robust cross-modal representations.
input_desc: 网页图像与未经精细清洗的 alt-text 对
input_en: Web image + minimally filtered raw alt-text description
output_desc: 共享空间中的图像和文本 embedding，用于检索与零样本分类
output_en: Shared-space image and text embeddings for cross-modal retrieval and zero-shot classification

source.title: ALIGN
notes: Transformers implements ALIGN using the Kakao Brain reproduction. Kakao model card says Google's original code was not released and this model uses COYO data. Not the original Google checkpoint.

adapter.name: ALIGN
adapter.mechanism: Pinned Transformers ALIGN: seven-stage EfficientNet MBConv/SE image tower, BERT text tower, normalized embeddings, learned temperature and symmetric label-smoothed contrastive loss.
limitations: Canonical Apache-2.0 library implementation follows the Kakao Brain reproduction; it is not Google's unreleased original training implementation or checkpoint.

Reduced width/depth with random initialization, 32-token synthetic vocabulary and two paired images replace web-scale noisy image-text training. All seven EfficientNet stage types remain; each has at least one block.

Vision initializer std=0.1 replaces the library's checkpoint-oriented 0.02, whose deep uncalibrated random tower can underflow during evaluation. Synthetic images use [-1,1] normalization without original data augmentation; no foundation retrieval or zero-shot performance is established.
